title: Unit Converter
description: Convert between different units of measurement with a flexible converter function.

steps.title: Kilometers to Miles
steps.description: Write a `kmToMiles` function that converts kilometers to miles. 1 km = 0.621371 miles.
hints: Make it a simple multiplication function

verification.failureMessage: kmToMiles(10) should be about 6.21371, kmToMiles(5) about 3.106855.

steps.title: Pounds to Kilograms
steps.description: Write a `lbsToKg` function that converts pounds to kilograms. 1 lb = 0.453592 kg.

verification.failureMessage: lbsToKg(1) should be about 0.453592, lbsToKg(10) about 4.53592.

steps.title: General convert function
steps.description: Write a `convert` function that takes a value, a from-unit, and a to-unit, and returns the converted value.
hints: Use a switch or if/else chain to handle different conversion types
Return a helpful message for unsupported conversions

codeTemplate.python:
def convert(value, fromUnit, toUnit):
  

print(convert(10, "km", "miles"))
print(convert(1, "lbs", "kg"))
print(convert(100, "kg", "lbs"))

steps.title: Format converted result
steps.description: Write a `formatConversion` function that returns a formatted string like `"10 km = 6.21 miles"` with 2 decimal places.
hints: Call convert to get the numeric result
Format both values to 2 decimal places with .toFixed(2)

verification.failureMessage: Each output should be like '10 km = 6.21 miles'.

steps.title: Convert an array of values
steps.description: Write a function that takes an array of values and converts all of them, returning an array of formatted strings.
hints: Use .map() in JS/TS or a list comprehension in Python
Return the array of formatted strings
